slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will keep you
calm in any chaos

watercolour painting

paint with watercolours for twenty minutes, without trying to make anything good. water and colour move at their own pace, and your breathing slows down to match.

tending houseplants

look after a few houseplants every morning: water, turn, check the leaves. small slow routines with living things are deeply calming for an anxious mind.

a gentle lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning something peaceful: the stars, an old painting, a myth. a calm mind needs calm things to think about, and curiosity is a gentle anchor.

slides.texte_overlay:
slow yoga

do ten minutes of slow stretching before bed. moving gently with your breath tells your nervous system that the day is over and you're finally safe to rest.

fishing

try fishing by a quiet lake or river. hours of patient waiting by water is one of the oldest and most effective ways humans have ever found to quiet the mind.
